content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Aircraft trading, leasing and used-parts resale is a different business from designing and certifying avionics."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Motion control motors and drives for equipment makers; no avionics or aircraft systems overlap."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Industrial MRO supply distributor with outsourced inventory services, not an avionics maker or certifier."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Diversified conglomerate; utility metering and filtration dominate, with aerospace valves only a minor part."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Cybersecurity hardware and subscriptions for networks; different products and customers from flight avionics."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Primarily an in-flight connectivity service sold by subscription, though its hardware is installed on the same aircraft."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Industrial pumps, valves and brake friction products; it shares only the aerospace label."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Design and lifecycle software for manufacturers; no hardware avionics or aircraft certification business."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Custom foam and plastic components made to OEM specifications; a contract manufacturer, not an avionics maker."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Semiconductor fabrication capital equipment with field service; different customers and products."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Telecom network test and optical components; aerospace test equipment is a small, separate line."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Engine leasing and engine maintenance business; no avionics design, manufacturing or certification."}]}
